item.title: Chinese - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Platform: HackMyVm
  • Difficulty: Easy
  • OS: Windows
  • Attacker IP: 192.168.155.142
  • Target Machine IP: 192.168.155.52

The objective was to enumerate the target, identify the exposed services, gain initial access by abusing a vulnerable Drupal 7 installation with Drupalgeddon2, and escalate privileges by modifying a root-owned script executed periodically by cron.

Port Scanning

RustScan

rustscan -a 192.168.155.52 -b 500 -- -sC -sV -A -oN nmap/init
